record.title: CELL3 legal ready-set after R79 downstream realization
record.body: CELL3 consumed the authoritative ForcedTop25 and fresh R79 Project state, then revalidated exact downstream subjects against live GitHub execution. Legality precedes priority. ex4pm#34 exact 38b181d4 has a successful R79 consumer court and multiple successful exact-head rails while broad ex4pm-ci remains in progress; GymAct#126 exact bcb14a65 has a successful repaired R79 consumer court and successful world-execution crown while broad CI remains in progress. Both are COMPATIBLE_READY for CELL4 qualification/closure because exact identity, authority, producer binding, reversible branch, and qualification path are observed. XaaS#31 exact 3b16d499 has successful R79 structural admission against current main and canonical marketplace ontology continuity, so U increases by one, but repository CI is red; it remains COMPATIBLE_NOT_READY pending classification/repair of that exact red rail before consumer realization/merge. Remaining ForcedTop25 targets preserve UNKNOWN_WITH_REASON[UPSTREAM_ADMISSIBILITY_RECEIPT_MISSING]; none are silently rejected. Project/control commits in chatgpt-cloud-elixir remain CONTROL and excluded from TRUE_FANOUT.
